---
title: "Summary Statistics of UAD PUF"
output: pdf_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Necessary packages
packages = c("tidyverse", "haven", "here", "usmap", "vtable", "kableExtra")

# Install then load or load

package.check <- lapply(packages, FUN = function(x) {
  # If not installed, install then load into the environment
  if (!require(x, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(x, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(x, character.only = TRUE)
  } else {
    # If already installed, load it into the environment
    library(x, character.only = TRUE)
  }
})

```

## Observations over time

```{r}

# Load dataset

df <- read_dta(here("data", "clean", "uad_clean.dta"))

df %>%
  group_by(program, year) %>%
  summarise(non_null_appraisals = sum(!is.na(appraised_value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = non_null_appraisals, fill = program)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2013:2022) +
    facet_wrap(~ program, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Count of Non-Null Appraisals", title = "Appraisals by Year and Program") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

## Geographic summary stats

```{r}

df %>%
  summarise(across(c("state_fips", "county_fips", "tract_fips"), ~ n_distinct(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  knitr::kable()

df %>% 
  count(state_fips, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  mutate(state_name = fips_info(state_fips)$full) %>%
  select(state_fips, state_name, count = n) %>%
  knitr::kable()

```

## Appraisal summary stats

```{r}

df %>%
  select(program, appraised_value, contract_price) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(appraised_value, contract_price), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  group_by(Variable, program) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean = mean(Value),
    `10th Percentile` = quantile(Value, 0.10),
    Median = median(Value),
    `90th Percentile` = quantile(Value, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"))

df %>% 
  filter(program == "enterprise", !is.na(appraised_value)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = appraised_value)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 10000, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
    labs(
      x = "Appraised Value",
      y = "Count",
      title = "Distribution of Enterprise Apprasied Value") +
    theme_minimal()

df %>% 
  filter(program == "fha", !is.na(appraised_value)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = appraised_value)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 10000, fill = "darkred", color = "white") +
    labs(
      x = "Appraised Value",
      y = "Count",
      title = "Distribution of FHA Apprasied Value") +
    theme_minimal()

```

## Appraisal to contract ratio

```{r}

df %>%
  filter(!is.na(appraisal_to_contract)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = appraisal_to_contract, fill = program)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, color = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~ program, scales = "free_y") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(85, 115)) +
    labs(x = "Appraisal-to-Contract Ratio (%)", y = "Count",
         title = "Appraised Value as a Percentage of Contract Price") +
    theme_minimal()

```

## Property characterstics

```{r}

df %>%
  select(quality, condition, bedrooms, bathrooms, lot_size, gross_living_area) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as_factor)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Value)) +
    geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
    facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Property Characteristics")

```
